help.stdout:
usage: gnd doctor [-h] [--claude] [--codex] [--global | --project]

Report every placed asset as current, stale, missing, modified or collided,
and print the two environment facts that explain most 'it did not work'
reports: the directory the running executable lives in with an on-PATH
verdict, and every target root inspected. BOTH scopes are always inspected,
whichever scope flag is given, because skill precedence puts the user level
ahead of the project level and a shadowed project install is the most common
confusing outcome. Exits 0 when everything is current, 10 on drift, 11 on a
collision, 12 when nothing is installed anywhere. Text output only, for the
reason `gnd install --help` gives (D-25). Scope: installed-asset state ONLY. A
green doctor says nothing about your model or its conformance state — in
particular it does not report a pending evolution finalization, which `gnd
evolve` reports and refuses. Reading exit 0 here as 'my model is fine' is the
one misreading this command cannot make for you.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --claude    target Claude Code's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --codex     target Codex CLI's skills directory (default: both runtimes)
  --global    user level (DEFAULT): ~/.claude/skills and $CODEX_HOME/skills
              (~/.codex/skills)
  --project   this project: ./.claude/skills and ./.codex/skills
